title: Lunarshot
description: Replace Minecraft's F2 screenshot feature with an improved version, copy and open directly from the chat!
body:
_I wanted a way to copy my screenshots directly from the chat. I tried to find mods that do just that but I didn't find any for my version, so I made my own._

**Replace Minecraft's F2 screenshot feature with an improved version that lets you open and copy screenshots directly from the chat.**

Inspired by the Lunar Client.
